run_simple_shuffle: run simple_shuffle to select a random healthy deployment from litellm router deployments
run_weighted_pick: run simple_shuffle with weight parameter to select deployment based on deployment weights
run_rpm_weighted_pick: run simple_shuffle with rpm parameter to select deployment based on requests per minute limits
run_tpm_weighted_pick: run simple_shuffle with tpm parameter to select deployment based on tokens per minute limits
run_random_pick: run simple_shuffle to perform an unweighted random selection from healthy deployments
